title: The ten retrieval strategies (incl. GraphRAG and the adaptive router) are built but never used by any turn or route
evidence: grep '\.retrieval\b|container\.retrieval' over aura_core/, aura_service.py, tests/ -> only tests/unit/test_knowledge_graph_pipeline.py:400-417
current_behavior: AURA_KNOWLEDGE_RETRIEVAL_STRATEGY is validated at boot and then has no effect; every turn is plain hybrid retrieval; the knowledge graph is written on every ingest and read by nothing in the request path (GAP-023 still true, also for 'adaptive').
expected_behavior: Selecting a strategy changes retrieval; GraphRAG/adaptive are reachable; ADR-005's graph-retrieval paragraph describes live behavior.
recommendation: Pass knowledge=self.retrieval (the facade already presents KnowledgeEngine.retrieve's signature) to KernelDependencies and the /knowledge/search route, with a fitness test; or relabel the strategies and graph as not-in-path in ADR-005, GAP-023 and the review.

title: Nightly refresh promotion is not recall-gated: no evaluator is wired
evidence: aura_backend/aura_core/learning/knowledge_refresh.py:321-330 recall only computed when evaluator is not None
aura_backend/aura_core/knowledge/index_manager.py:109-118 recall gate skipped when either recall is None
current_behavior: Only chunk-count, error-rate and min-chunks gates apply; a rebuild that loses recall promotes; max_recall_drop is dead configuration.
expected_behavior: The recall@5 regression gate documented in ADR-007/008 runs, or the ADRs say it does not.
recommendation: Wire RetrievalEvaluator with the committed docs_corpus suite as the refresh evaluator and add a lifecycle test that a recall drop blocks promotion; or mark the recall gate not implemented in ADR-007/008 and the gap register.

title: With an unchanged embedder the refresh candidate is the live index: 'never modified' and rollback do not hold, and the corpus is re-embedded nightly
evidence: aura_backend/aura_core/knowledge/index_manager.py:208-212,218-247 build() upserts every chunk into target
aura_backend/aura_core/knowledge/index_manager.py:334-335 promote repoints alias to the same name
current_behavior: Every chunk is embedded twice per night (ingest then build) and written in place into the serving collection; rollback is an alias repoint to itself; retention is meaningless unless the embedding model changed.
expected_behavior: A refresh builds a separate generation (or skips build when identity is unchanged) so the ADR-007 safety property is real and the nightly cost is one embedding pass.
recommendation: Include the GenerationId in refresh build names and make prune retention real, or skip build() when candidate == previous and document that same-embedder refreshes are incremental; document the embedding cost.

title: The non-semantic hash embedder is the default, is not refused in production despite the code claiming it is, and nothing committed pins what the Railway gateway uses
evidence: aura_backend/aura_core/llm/embeddings.py:63-72 'Not semantic ... AuraSettings.validate() refuses ... in staging or production'
grep 'local-embeddings|hash-embed' in settings.py -> only :626-627,680-681; no check in validate()
docs/deployment/control-plane.md:56-87 Railway env list has no AURA_EMBEDDING_*
grep 'embedding' in aura_backend/aura_service.py -> no match (readiness does not report the embedder)
current_behavior: If the Railway dashboard does not set the variable, production retrieval and memory run on character-n-gram hashing and nothing in /health/* reveals it. Live value UNKNOWN.
expected_behavior: Production refuses the hash embedder (as the docstring promises) or readiness exposes the active embedder; the Railway runbook names the variable.
recommendation: Add the refusal to AuraSettings.validate() for staging/production; add embedding {provider, model, dimension} to /health/ready; add AURA_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER/MODEL/DIMENSION to control-plane.md and verify the live value.

title: What the model sees of retrieved knowledge is at most 2 x 280 characters, plus <=3 memories in 80 tokens and an 80-token CAG prefix
current_behavior: ~80% of every retrieved chunk is cut before the prompt; citations name a page/heading whose text the model mostly did not read; the evaluation suite scores retrieval ids, not the clipped prompt, so the gate cannot see this.
expected_behavior: Prompt budget sized to the deployed context window (several full chunks for 8k+ contexts) with the clip as a last resort, and an answer-quality eval over the real prompt path.
recommendation: Treat prompt_chunk_max_chars/top_k as per-deployment capacity settings documented in control-plane.md/compose; raise defaults for non-CPU providers; add the ContextGroundedProvider answer suite over the rendered prompt.

title: Document chunks and every vector payload are plaintext, including on Qdrant Cloud in the Railway target; memory subject is plaintext in the vector payload
current_behavior: A Qdrant Cloud operator or API-key leak exposes every user's document text and memory subjects; ADR-004 explicitly leaves this uncovered.
expected_behavior: A recorded decision for chunks and third-party vector stores; at minimum no readable content in off-host vector payloads.
recommendation: Add a vector_payload_content setting (off when Qdrant is off-host) and resolve chunk text from the owner-scoped document store (the engine already does this for lexical-only hits, engine.py:797-813); cover chunks in the encryption ADR.

title: MemoryEngine.forget_source cannot delete vectors: it filters on a payload key that is never written
evidence: aura_backend/aura_core/memory/engine.py:177-184 payload keys: memory_id, kind, owner_id, subject, scope
current_behavior: Rows are deleted, vector points orphaned; docstring claims the points are removed. Dead code today, latent bug for ADR-004's 'forget everything from X'.
recommendation: Add source (provenance) to the memory vector payload, or delete by the ids returned from delete_by_provenance; add a test.

title: In-process BM25 index is rebuilt from the entire document store in every process at startup; ADR-005's Postgres FTS scale-out path is not built
evidence: docs/status/BACKEND_STATUS.md:56 ('the 200k point and Postgres FTS are open')
current_behavior: Each gateway/worker process holds a full copy of all tenants' postings; memory and boot time grow with corpus x process count; no ceiling documented.
expected_behavior: A stated corpus ceiling and a tested FTS adapter behind the same port before it is reached.
recommendation: Record the ceiling from LEXICAL_RETRIEVAL_BENCHMARK.md in the capacity doc; build the FTS adapter when the 200k measurement is taken (M5).

title: Memory consolidation never merges: 'merged' is always 0
evidence: aura_backend/aura_core/memory/engine.py:131-143 merge happens only at write time
current_behavior: Duplicates that slip past the write-time check persist until decay expires one.
expected_behavior: Consolidation merges near-duplicates, or the docstring/ADR say merging is write-time only.
recommendation: Decide and align; if implemented, reuse _find_duplicate over list_for_owner with the policy threshold.

title: No automatic memory extraction exists; memory is written only by the remember tool, POST /memory, or the kernel's session-classification note
current_behavior: Learning about the user happens only when the model calls the tool; provenance extractor fields are never populated by a background extractor.
expected_behavior: Documented as the design (tool-driven memory) or an extractor exists.
recommendation: Documentation decision; no code change required.

title: Embedding and reranker weights load by name with no revision pin; the index identity cannot detect a silent upstream change
evidence: aura_backend/aura_core/domain/knowledge.py:215-219 identity is the model id string
current_behavior: A re-published BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 changes vectors; new chunks go into the same collection as old ones with no rebuild and no error.
expected_behavior: Pinned revision plus recorded digest, folded into the identity or a startup check.
recommendation: Add AURA_EMBEDDING_REVISION, pass revision= to SentenceTransformer, fold the revision into IndexIdentity.embedding_model_id or assert it against alias metadata at startup.

title: Evaluation gate triggers on PR/push but every quality number is hash-embedder/scripted-provider and nothing has run since CB-44
current_behavior: The gate can only catch regressions of the hash-embedder pipeline; the production embedder and the clipped prompt (D-05) are unmeasured; no runner executes it.
expected_behavior: A real-embedder retrieval report and a real-model answer report (GAP-021 exit condition).
recommendation: Run evaluation/runner.py once against sentence-transformers + hosted1 and commit the report; keep the deterministic gate as the merge gate.

title: On the Railway production target Loop B cannot run a job to completion, and an approved dataset does not survive a redeploy
current_behavior: A queued job stays QUEUED forever; an inline job ends NOT_TRAINED; after a Railway redeploy enqueue/run for an approved digest fails with 'dataset is not stored' while the approval row persists. Live state UNKNOWN.
expected_behavior: The documented loop is runnable on the live target or documented as dataset-preparation-only there (GAP-017 option b).
recommendation: Store datasets in Postgres (digest-keyed JSONL) or object storage so approval and artefact share a lifetime; state in control-plane.md that Loop B on Railway stops at approval.

title: A trained LoRA adapter can be registered and promoted but never serves; promotion to production is a no-op for every artefact LocalLoraTrainer produces
evidence: aura_backend/aura_core/api/admin.py:491 (imported Ollama tag path; router behavior with an unknown tag on Railway not traced)
current_behavior: ADR-008 Loop B ends at a CANDIDATE row; GAP-017 target (a) unmet; the registry's production stage can point at something no provider can load.
expected_behavior: Promotion refused for non-servable artefacts, or a merge/convert/serve step exists; the registry records servability.
recommendation: Make ModelRegistry.transition(to=CANARY|PRODUCTION) refuse artefacts _servable_model_tag would discard (move the helper to the domain); long term, GAP-017's merge/convert/serve step on a GPU host.

title: A second, legacy learning and ingestion path is still mounted in the v3 gateway and bypasses ADR-008 and KnowledgeEngine
evidence: aura_backend/tasks.py:8-9,110-126 module-scope legacy imports; JSON-file dataset builder
current_behavior: An Admin can produce an un-curated, un-approved dataset via /api/v3/learning/build_dataset; Drive sync can index PDFs that never pass the context guard. Client reachability of the Drive path not traced (UNKNOWN).
expected_behavior: One learning path (ADR-008) and one ingestion path (ADR-005/006 guard).
recommendation: Remove or 410 the /api/v3/learning/* router and build_lora_dataset_task; route ingest_pdf_task through KnowledgeEngine.ingest(segments=...); drop the module-scope legacy imports from tasks.py.

title: Fine-tune queue drain builds a new container every 120 s, and enqueue reaches into ApprovalService's private store
evidence: deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml:889 (--max-tasks-per-child=1 bounds the leak on worker-training)
current_behavior: Bounded by process recycling on worker-training; would accumulate pools on any other consumer; private access bypasses ApprovalService's own lookup.
expected_behavior: Workers share one container per process; services use public APIs.
recommendation: Use _ensure_worker_container() in _drain_finetune_queue; add ApprovalService.get() and call it.

title: Status and gap documentation for learning is out of date in both directions
evidence: docs/status/BACKEND_STATUS.md:69 'GAP-018 (a failed train is recorded as success)' vs aura_core/learning/finetune.py:444-448,508-533 and tests/unit/test_finetune_honesty.py:107-143
docs/production/gap_register.yaml:470-481 GAP-017 current_state cites code that no longer exists
docs/guides/mlops-guide.md:6-7 'Loop A ... Gated automatically' (recall gate unwired, D-02)
docs/status/BACKEND_STATUS.md:57 'F-16 write races open' vs commit 8b34504; :66 'eval-ci.yml is dispatch-only' vs .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml:26-73
current_behavior: Readers believe a P1 honesty bug and F-16 are open and that eval CI never triggers; readers of GAP-017's current_state believe the trainer still fabricates artefacts.
recommendation: Update BACKEND_STATUS.md:57,66,69; rewrite GAP-017's current_state; qualify mlops-guide.md's Loop A gating claim.

title: No committed evidence of a weight-changing run, and no evaluation of any trained artefact against the base model
evidence: aura_backend/aura_core/mlops/model_registry.py:238-251 (canary gate reads metrics no trainer path writes)
current_behavior: 'Fine-tuning works' rests on an uncommitted local run on hf-internal-testing/tiny-random-gpt2; the registry's only automatic quality gate is inert.
expected_behavior: GAP-017's exit condition: a report in docs/reports/ with base revision, dataset digest, eval delta and approval id.
recommendation: Run pytest tests/training -m training on a host with requirements-train.txt and commit the output; have the job engine call AnswerEvaluator on base vs adapter and write coverage_drop so the canary gate has data.
